Name: Floating Bubble
Description: You point to an unoccupied space of your choice within range that you can see and conjure a large bubble, measuring two feet in diameter, which hovers one inch above the ground. The bubble may remain still or move 10 feet per round in any horizontal direction, chosen when you cast the spell. One Medium or smaller creature may climb and sit atop the bubble, which is unaffected by the rider’s weight (Large or bigger creatures cause the bubble to burst). The bubble may be pushed by a creature or blown by the wind to alter its direction. On your turn, you can cause the bubble to rise or fall 10 feet, to a maximum of 300 feet from the elevation it was cast at. The bubble has an AC of 10, 15 hit points, immunity to poison and psychic damage, and vulnerability to piercing damage. If two or more creatures attempt to ride the bubble, it bursts immediately.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you summon an additional bubble for each spell slot used. Each bubble summoned ascends and descends uniformly, regardless of their distance from one another.
